g.text: The run asks the rollout runtime for episodes. It sets up each one's environment, your agent acts in it,

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: and its verifier scores the result. Every model call the agent makes goes through the model client, which records

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: the exact tokens the sampler returned. The run joins tokens and rewards into training batches, and the

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: trainer publishes each new policy to the sampler.
